# .github

## Purpose
GitHub repository configuration including CI/CD workflows and funding information.

## Key Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `FUNDING.yml` | Sponsorship/funding configuration |

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `workflows/` | GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows |

## Workflows

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `ci.yml` | Continuous integration: lint, test, typecheck |
| `deploy-pages.yml` | Deploy GitHub Pages (admin UI) |
| `dockerhub.yml` | Build and push to Docker Hub |
| `release.yml` | Release automation |
| `release-docker.yml` | Docker release workflow |
